Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single creature sprite concept for ChibiBeasts, a warm creature-collecting Discord RPG.
Primary request: authentic, VERY SIMPLE 8-bit pixel game sprite. It should look designed on a 32 by 32 pixel canvas and enlarged with nearest-neighbor scaling. Each visible pixel block must be the same square size on a consistent coarse grid. Character itself about 24 by 26 logical pixels, centered with generous transparent padding. One character only, entire body visible, slight three-quarter view.
Style: tiny cute chibi proportions, large head and short limbs, clear silhouette, thick stair-stepped pixel outline, very sparse flat color clusters, at most 7 opaque colors including the dark outline, only one shadow shade per material. Charm through silhouette and pose, minimal surface detail. No antialiasing, gradients, bloom, soft edges, texture noise, smooth curves, 3D rendering, painterly lighting, elaborate illustration, fine details, scenery, floor, ground shadow, border, words, labels, UI, or watermark.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no checkerboard drawn into the image. Crisp uniform square pixels, designed to remain readable when tiny.
Subject: Prismite. Description from the project: "A tiny floating kitten built from smooth porcelain-like shapes, with glowing golden diamond eyes and a halo that never quite stops turning." Depict a tiny floating porcelain-white kitten, simple compact seated pose with paws tucked near body, two pointed ears, one short curled tail, exactly TWO golden diamond-shaped eyes, and one small golden pixel ring halo floating above its head. Friendly composed expression. Porcelain body represented by white, one pale blue shadow and the dark navy outline; halo and eyes in two gold tones. No forehead jewel, no wings, no ornaments, no extra symbols, no clock. Floating indicated by pose and clear space below, not glow or shadow. Keep the whole silhouette extremely simple and about 24 logical pixels tall.
